I'm sorry! Sumimasen! But you don't have
enough space in your PC Box.{VAR BE01}
Please make room for six Pokémon and
try again.

DS Wireless Communications will
be launched.
OK, OK. Come here. Stand right there!{VAR BE01}
Well, let's begin! Allons-y!{VAR BE01}
Great! Molto bene!{VAR BE01}

I put the Pokémon you caught
in your PC Box.{VAR BE01}

But, it seems you could not
catch any Pokémon.{VAR BE01}

W-w-what? You!
You have all the Gym Badges?!{VAR BE01}

Great!
You may be able to...{VAR BE01}
Professor Paaaaaark!{VAR BE01}
Quick, quick!{VAR BE01}
Oh, there you are!{VAR BE01}

What? You have the Gym Badges?
ALL of them?!{VAR BE01}

Fantastic!{VAR BE01}
Fantastico!{VAR BE01}
Yahoooooooooooooooo!{VAR BE01}
...So! You!{VAR BE01}
